summary.text: Morgan Thiel is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 30 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A project coordinator at Thiel Brothers Roofing, she serves on the House Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Business and Labor committees.

paragraphs.text: Morgan Thiel earned a high school diploma from Sidney High School in 2013 and attended Sheridan College and Evangel University.
Her career experience includes working as a project coordinator at Thiel Brothers Roofing.
Thiel won the House District 30 general election on November 5, 2024, and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Business and Labor committees.
